mathematical_review.actual_density_and_outer_product: ρXY is trZ(|Ω⟩⟨Ω|), constructed from the physical vector. PΩ is the same physical outer product lifted through both ancillary identities and the explicit reassociation. For arbitrary Ω it is an outer product; unit Ω gives an orthogonal projection and trρXY=1. No normalization is silently assumed in the general contraction formula.
mathematical_review.factor_order: The enlarged index is (((s,e),(X,Y)),Z). PΩ contracts only the physical (a,z) coordinate and preserves both s,e. The copied vector reads the original X coordinate from e and inserts s/X blanks. The operator entry has the identity δ(e,e′), conjugate input blanks and the physical Q*T order.
mathematical_review.unit_blank_contractions: Unit s and X blanks contract Σ conjugate(b)b and Σ conjugate(c)c to one. The resulting R0φ entry is w_s Σ_jk Q[a,(s,k)] T[k,j] Ω[e,j,z]. No projection, normalization of Ω, or spectral relation is assumed for this algebraic entry formula.
mathematical_review.coefficient_orientation: The actual M_X=trY((IX⊗T)ρXY Q) has entry M[e,s]=Σ_azjk conjugate(Ω[a,z]) Q[a,(s,k)] T[k,j] Ω[e,j,z]. Thus g[s,e,a,z]=w_s M[e,s] Ω[a,z]. For selected s, the ancillary coefficient is M[e,s]/sqrt(p_s), matching M_yx/sqrt(p_x). Neither transpose nor extra conjugation is inserted.
mathematical_review.nonreal_regression: The source consumer uses Ω=(1,i), Q=T=I, E={false}, p=(1,0), and unit coordinate blanks. Its tested off-diagonal ground coefficient is +i. Direct substitution agrees with M[true,false]=i, while transposition/conjugation would give −i. This consumer is source-inspected, not compiled here.
mathematical_review.squared_norm: For unit Ω and unit s/X blanks, summing |g|² over the physical coordinates contributes ||Ω||²=1. Selected p_x>0 gives |w_x|²=1/p_x. The selected x sum and unrestricted y sum therefore equal the actual squared ground norm. The column expression needs only the X/e blank units, as stated separately.
mathematical_review.singular_coefficient_bound: A positive diagonal actual reference has p_x≥0 and support inverse diag(p_x^-1), with 0^-1=0. The Hermitian relation M_xy=conjugate(M_yx) gives Re tr(Mρ+M)=Σ_xy |M_yx|²/p_x. Omitting nonnegative columns yields the selected bound, including selected zero-weight coordinates for the generic coefficient lemma. The trace sandwich bound uses M≤ρ but no commutation or diagonal hypothesis.
mathematical_review.actual_marginal_and_trace_chain: The final theorem assumes Q,T are orthogonal projections, actual ρXY commutes with Q, and the actual marginal trYρXY equals diag(p). Previously proved marginal order supplies 0≤M_X≤ρ_X. Combining the literal coefficient identity, selected trace bound and Re trM_X≤trρ_X=trρXY=1 gives ||PΩR0φ||²≤1 and hence its norm≤1. Q need not commute with IX⊗T, and the marginal may be singular.
mathematical_review.normalization_scope: The final bound requires unit Ω and the s/X blanks and positivity only at selected coordinates. It does not require an e blank until the independent initial-column-vector expression is requested. The real traces are intentional; positivity makes the underlying traces real.
